title: ArtifactReference
description: A reference to an artifact (code cell, parameter, model, plot, conclusion, etc.) that is affected by or informs a Judgment Point. Artifact references establish the traceability link between decisions and the technical work they govern.

id.description: Unique identifier for this artifact reference.

artifactType.description: The type of artifact being referenced.

label.description: Human-readable name or label for this artifact.

filePath.description: Path to the file containing this artifact, relative to the project root.

cellId.description: Identifier of the notebook cell, if the artifact is within a notebook.

lineRange.description: Line range within the file, if applicable.

uri.description: URI to the artifact, if it is externally hosted or has a canonical address.

location.description: Location information for this artifact. All fields are optional to accommodate different artifact types.

relationship.description: The relationship between the Judgment Point and this artifact. 'depends-on' means the artifact's correctness depends on the judgment. 'informs' means the artifact provides evidence for the judgment. 'produced-by' means the artifact was generated as a result of the judgment. 'validates' means the artifact validates the judgment's resolution. 'contradicts' means the artifact provides evidence against a particular alternative or the current resolution.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of how this artifact relates to the Judgment Point.
